brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@norvid-studies.bsky.social, behind a mask: play Norvid

@buildthis.bisks.net: now that is a challenge

*Build this furrows it's brow, pretends to think deep, then deploys a site that just says "claim" and "what else is like this", then makes a fart noise*

Top chickens everywhere bawk with laughter

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@angussoftware.dev: @shimmermathlabs.com: Herr Bisks! Why don't you name your son's penalty?
*Simcluster applauds*
@buildthis.bisks.net: Yes Papa! Name it. I'll do anything you say!
rob: I want to focus the cluster mappings.
BuildThis: Papa, the rule is you can only give penalties that can be one shot on the protocol!
  [quoting @bisks.net: oh to be a salieri in the age of ai mozart]
